title: Psychic set
html:
The Psychic set is a set of equipment that deals or synergizes with ⁠Psychic damage and inflicts  Mental Fatigue. The set consists of the following pieces:

Name Slot Effect

Blade of Oppressed Souls 		 Main Hand Melee (Longsword)
  • Deal an additional 1d4⁠⁠Psychic damage.
Crowning Strike ()

Unleash the wails of the dead that fell to your blade, and possibly instil  Crown of Madness in the target.


Bonespike Helmet 		 Headgear (Non-Armour)
  •  Intimidation +2

 Menacing Attack

This ability does not consume Superiority Dice. ( Recharge: Per turn.)
Fury In The Marrow
When you  Rage, hostile creatures in a 3 m / 10 ft radius must succeed a Weapon action DC  Wisdom saving throw or take 2d4⁠⁠Psychic damage. The targets receive half damage on a save.

Boots of Psionic Movement 		 Footwear (Medium Armour)
  • Dexterity  Saving Throws +1
 Githborn: Flying Boots ()
Cast as a level 3 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)
Flying Strike
When a githyanki casts  Fly, their next melee weapon attack deals an additional 1d4⁠⁠Psychic damage.

Braindrain Gloves 		 Gloves (Non-Armour)
Mental Interference
When you deal ⁠Psychic damage, you also inflict  Mental Fatigue for 2 turns.

Circlet of Psionic Revenge 		 Headgear (Non-Armour)
Psionic Revenge
When you succeed a  Saving throw, the foe that caused the throw takes 1d4⁠⁠Psychic. Githyanki also gain a +1 bonus to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma  Saving throws.

Githyanki Greatsword (Psionic) 		 Main Hand Melee (Greatsword)
Githborn Psionic Weapon
When wielded by a githyanki this weapon deals an additional 1d4⁠⁠Psychic damage.

Justiciar's Scimitar 		 Main Hand Melee (Scimitar)
Shadow-Blinding
If you attack with  Advantage, you have a chance to  Blind your target.[See: Bugs]
Shadowsoaked Blow ()

Strike an enemy, adding your proficiency bonus to the damage. Moreover, if the attack hits, it deals an additional 1d6⁠⁠Psychic damage. This attack doesn't break concealment.


Ketheric's Warhammer 		 Main Hand Melee (Warhammer)
  • Deal an additional 1d4⁠⁠Psychic damage.

Psionic Ward Armour 		 Armour (Medium Armour)
Psionic Ward
If the item detects that the wearer is gith, they have Resistance to ⁠Psychic damage.
Whenever the wearer succeeds on a  Saving Throw against a spell, they regain 1d4⁠⁠Hit Points.

Render of Mind and Body 		 Main Hand Melee (Shortsword)
Psychic Steel Virtuoso
When the wielder attacks with  Advantage, they deal an additional 1d8⁠⁠Psychic.

Ring of Mental Inhibition 		 Ring
Mental Inhibition
When a foe fails a  Saving Throw against one of your spells or actions, they gain  Mental Fatigue for 2 turns.

Shadow Blade Ring 		 Ring
 Shadow Blade ( + )
Cast as a level 2 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)

Silver Sword of the Astral Plane 		 Main Hand Melee (Greatsword)
Githborn Psionic Weapon
When wielded by a githyanki this weapon deals an additional 1d6⁠⁠Psychic damage.
Githborn Psionic Resistance
A githyanki holding this weapon has  Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma  Saving Throws, resistance to Psychic damage, and cannot be  Charmed.
Soulbreaker ()

Rend the enemy's body and soul, dealing additional ⁠Psychic damage equal to your proficiency bonus, and possibly  Stun them.


Slinging Shoes 		 Footwear (Non-Armour)
  • Dexterity  Saving Throws +1
Shoe Slinger
Returns to its owner when thrown. On a hit deal an additional 2d4⁠⁠Psychic damage.

Soulbreaker Greatsword 		 Main Hand Melee (Greatsword)
Githborn Psionic Weapon
When wielded by a githyanki this weapon deals an additional 1d4⁠⁠Psychic damage.
Soulbreaker ()

Rend the enemy's body and soul, dealing additional ⁠Psychic damage equal to your proficiency bonus, and possibly  Stun them.


Strange Conduit Ring 		 Ring
Strange Conduit
When Concentrating on a spell, the wearer's weapon attacks deal an additional 1d4⁠⁠Psychic damage.

Sword of Clutching Umbra 		 Main Hand Melee (Shortsword)
Shadowsoaked Blow ()

Strike an enemy, adding your proficiency bonus to the damage. Moreover, if the attack hits, it deals an additional 1d6⁠⁠Psychic damage. This attack doesn't break concealment.


Sword of Screams 		 Main Hand Melee (Rapier)
  • Deal an additional 1d4⁠⁠Psychic damage.

Voss' Silver Sword 		 Main Hand Melee (Longsword)
  • Deal an additional 1d4⁠⁠Psychic damage.
Interplanar Slayer
This weapon grants a +1d4 bonus to damage and  Attack rolls against githyanki, aberrations, fiends, and elementals.
 Wrathful Smite ( + + )
Cast as a level 1 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)
